item.title: Google Launches Gemini 3.7 Flash as Workhorse Model for Agent Developers
item.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini 3.7 Flash on August 13, 2026—a multimodal reasoning model with a 1M-token context window, configurable thinking modes, and broad agent-tool support including function calling, computer use (preview), and file search, positioned as the company's primary workhorse for coding and agentic workloads.
